headline: Market Heartbeat 14/09: GEX, GEE and GEL shares hit floor price; foreign investors return to net buying in blue-chip group
summary: The VN-Index fell nearly 7 points to 1,788.23 points, while the HNX-Index dropped 0.74 points. Declining stocks outnumbered advancers 455 to 203, and foreign investors returned to net buying in blue chips.
why: The VN-Index is the benchmark index of Ho Chi Minh City's main exchange, tracking the largest listed Vietnamese companies.
